tools.title: Confluence

servers.name: Atlassian Rovo MCP Server
servers.capabilities: Read, write and search Confluence pages; same server also covers Jira, Bitbucket Cloud, Compass and Loom.

tools.notes: Confluence Cloud only, same server as Jira. API token auth must be enabled by an org admin; the legacy SSE endpoint /v1/sse was retired after 30 June 2026.

tools.title: Context7
tools.summary: Up-to-date, version-specific library documentation for coding agents.

servers.name: Context7 MCP
servers.capabilities: resolve-library-id and query-docs: fetch current documentation and code examples for libraries.

tools.notes: The API key (Authorization: Bearer) is recommended for higher rate limits rather than mandatory; npx ctx7 setup can configure it.

tools.title: Documentalist
tools.summary: Documentation portal that synchronises Markdown and MDX from a repository and imports OpenAPI.

servers.name: Documentalist MCP

settings.name: domain
settings.description: Hostname of the HTTPS Documentalist instance, such as docs.example.org, without the scheme or /mcp.

servers.capabilities: Read-only access to published documentation: list_spaces, list_pages, search_docs and read_page. Bearer keys grant access to explicitly selected private spaces.

access.consent: Public publications require no consent; private publications require a scoped Documentalist key
scopes: Public publications or private publications allowed by the key

tools.notes: Public publications are accessible without authentication. Use --token-env for private publications with a scoped Documentalist key. OpenGuildKit also prepares the folders Documentalist imports with `openguildkit docs export` and keeps the share register with `openguildkit docs share`.

tools.title: Docusaurus
tools.summary: Static site generator for documentation websites.
tools.notes: No official MCP server found on 2026-11-21. Third-party plugins exist (for example docusaurus-plugin-mcp-server) but none is clearly established.

tools.title: GitBook

servers.name: GitBook MCP
servers.capabilities: Create and configure sites, open change requests, draft and edit pages, restructure docs.

tools.notes: Personal access token goes in Authorization: Bearer; limit 5,000 requests per hour per token. Published GitBook sites also expose a read-only MCP at <site>/~gitbook/mcp.

tools.title: Mintlify
tools.summary: Hosted documentation platform for developer docs.

servers.name: Mintlify admin MCP
servers.capabilities: Read, edit, restructure and publish docs, create automations and manage settings.

tools.notes: Non-interactive credentials are read-only; edits need OAuth and write access to the deploy branch. Every Mintlify site also exposes a read-only search MCP at <site>/mcp (and /authed/mcp for protected docs).

tools.title: Notion
tools.summary: Connected workspace for docs, wikis and databases.

servers.name: Notion MCP
servers.capabilities: Search and fetch pages, create and update pages, comments, databases and views, file uploads.

access.consent: Sign in to Notion and approve the connection for the intended workspace
scopes: Pages and databases reachable through the signed-in user's Notion permissions

tools.notes: OAuth by default; MCP bearer tokens can be created by workspace owners on Business and Enterprise. Legacy SSE endpoint https://mcp.notion.com/sse retires in February 2027. The open-source local server (makenotion/notion-mcp-server) is no longer actively maintained and only a last resort.

tools.title: ReadMe
tools.summary: Hosted API documentation and developer hub platform.

servers.name: ReadMe's MCP Server
servers.capabilities: Search ReadMe docs, read and update project pages, branches, settings and API specs, draft changelogs.

tools.notes: Authenticates with a project API key (Authorization: Bearer rdme_...), one key per project. Separately, each ReadMe project can enable an MCP server for its own readers.

tools.title: Swagger / OpenAPI tooling
tools.summary: API design, documentation and portal tools around the OpenAPI specification.

servers.name: Swagger MCP (SmartBear remote)
servers.capabilities: Swagger Portal and Studio management: APIs, domains, AI-assisted API generation and standardization.

servers.name: SmartBear MCP (local, all products)
servers.capabilities: Single server for SmartBear products; Swagger tools need SWAGGER_API_KEY, functional testing its own token.

tools.notes: Covers SmartBear's Swagger products, not the open-source Swagger UI/Editor alone. The remote transport is not named in SmartBear's page; its registry entry says streamable HTTP. Base path variables are optional settings for on-premise installs.
